account_deletion.default_title: Vendora — Premium Event Planning & Vendor Marketplace
account_deletion.title: Delete your account
account_deletion.applies: Applies to the Vendora and Vendora for Vendors apps. Last updated: June 17, 2026.
account_deletion.intro: You can permanently delete your Vendora account and its associated data at any time. Here's how, and exactly what happens to your data.

app.title: 1. Delete it from the app (fastest)
app.step_open: Open the app and sign in.
app.result: Your account is deleted immediately and you're signed out. This cannot be undone.

email.title: 2. Or request it by email
email.body: If you can't sign in, email hello@eventvendora.com from the email address on your account, with the subject "Delete my account." We verify ownership and complete the deletion within 30 days.

deleted.title: 3. What gets deleted
deleted.login: Your login (email and password) and profile.
deleted.listings: Your vendor listings and the portfolio / gallery photos you uploaded.
deleted.messages: Your messages, inquiries, and conversation threads.
deleted.saved: Saved searches, saved vendors, and planning data.

kept.title: 4. What's kept, and for how long
kept.audit: Anonymized moderation / audit records — kept with your personal identifiers removed, for safety and abuse prevention.
kept.legal: Records required by law (e.g. tax or fraud-prevention records) — retained only as long as the law requires, then deleted.
kept.backups: Encrypted backups — purged on a rolling basis, within 30 days of deletion.

questions.title: 5. Questions
questions.body: Email <mail>hello@eventvendora.com</mail> and we'll help. See our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> for more on how we handle your data.
